demo.cliff: a lot is not a thing you own
teaches: tons is the size of the lot, basePrice what a ton of it is worth before any modifier, and farePerTon what a freight lot pays to carry.
purchaseDM[] and saleDM[] are the trade-code modifiers, one row per code, and they are stored on the lot rather than looked up.
purchasePct records what was actually paid as a percentage of base, which is what a later sale is measured against.
illegal and legality are two different questions: what the law says, and how far it goes.
demo.trap: destination.world is left empty, exactly as on the passage. It is a cross-Actor UUID and a single drag out of a compendium does not keep document ids, so destination.name is what survives. dueDay is a day-stamp on the world clock, not a countdown: nothing decrements it.

system.description: Sealed drums of marsh-cut fibre, bound out-system. Nobody asks what it is for.
